capabilities.text: Build the motion from up to six segments in any order
capabilities.note: Built in batch 4, round 150 (2026-11-08). Ours is a fixed sequence: speed up, constant velocity, slow down, rest.

capabilities.text: Set each segment at rest, constant velocity forward or back, speeding up or slowing down
capabilities.note: Built in batch 4, round 151 (2026-11-08). Wider form of cap-01f: only one direction for the whole motion, and the four phases are fixed in order (a phase can only be shortened).

capabilities.text: Type how long each segment lasts
capabilities.note: Narrow form of cap-01a/01b: durations of our four fixed phases (speed up, constant, slow down, rest).

capabilities.text: Type each segment's speed
capabilities.note: Built in batch 4, round 152 (2026-11-08). Wider form of cap-01g: we type one acceleration for the whole motion.

capabilities.text: Set where the motion starts
capabilities.note: Built in batch 4, round 153 (2026-11-08). No starting position parameter.

capabilities.text: Run the whole motion forward or back
capabilities.note: Narrow form of cap-01b: one direction for every segment.

capabilities.text: Set how fast it speeds up and slows down (one acceleration for the whole motion)
Put a dot every 0.5 s, 1 s or 2 s
Write the times under the dots
Put a letter on every dot
Put the motion graph's letters at the segment ends
Draw velocity arrows on one scale
capabilities.note: Arrows are on at the opening state; the evidence is that removing them changes the map.

capabilities.text: Draw an acceleration arrow (or a = 0) above each segment
Dots only, for students to add the arrows
Draw the total displacement as an arrow under the number line
Write the displacement's label, a blank line, or leave it off
Numbers on the number line, or just the shape
Mark the origin
Label the object (text, blank line or none)
Add a chart title
Print an answer key under the figure
Label size
Color for slides
capabilities.note: Built in batch 4, round 163 (2026-11-08). No color parameter on our motion map.

capabilities.text: Start from, or open as, the motion graph with the same segments
capabilities.note: not-doing: "Links that open the same data as a different figure (motion graph ↔ motion map). Our figures are separate tools; a teacher copies the values across."
